SQUIRE is recognized as one of the fastest-growing software technology platforms in the barbershop industry, which is valued at around a hundred billion dollars globally.

about_short_description.short_description: SQUIRE is a barbershop business management system that includes tools for booking, scheduling, payment processing, and marketing management.

product.name: Flex Branded App
product.description: A customizable mobile app for clients to book appointments, make payments, and access loyalty programs under a barber's brand.

product.name: Online Booking
product.description: A system enabling clients to schedule appointments with barbers through web or mobile platforms.

product.name: Payments
product.description: A payment processing system supporting online and in-person transactions with same-day deposits.

product.name: Appointment Reminders
product.description: Automated text message reminders sent to clients to reduce late arrivals and no-shows.

product.name: Promo Codes
product.description: A tool for creating and managing discount codes to incentivize client bookings and purchases.

product.name: Loyalty Program
product.description: A client rewards system to encourage repeat business through points or benefits.
